entries.title: Chess Club for Kids
entries.description: Come learn to play chess, or just play a game!

entries.title: Chess for Beginners
entries.description: \nWhether you’re brand new to the game or looking to sharpen your skills, you’re invited to learn and play chess in a relaxed, supportive environment.

entries.description: Bring your own project or start a new one as we refine our skills and discuss all things crochet.

entries.description: Do you want to learn how, see what others are working on, refine your skills, or talk about all kinds of hand needle crafts?

entries.title: Cambrian Pokemon Club
entries.description: Join us to have fun playing Pokemon, trading cards, and learning strategies for improving your game!

entries.title: Adaptive Activities - Dance and Movement
entries.description: Caregivers are welcomed to join.nbsp;This month we’ll be practicing Dance and Movement!

entries.title: Music and Movement with Stay&Play
entries.description: Join usnbsp;for Music and Movement storytime.\nMusic and Movement is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities through songs, rhymes, finger plays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Vietnamese Storytime with ICAN
entries.description: Vietnamese Storytime with ICAN welcomes children and their caregivers to participate in early literacy activities in both Vietnamese and English.

entries.title: Creative Writing Workshop
entries.description: Whether you've written for years or started yesterday, register for fresh inspiration to make your story shine!

entries.title: Educational Park Art Club
entries.description: \nJoin us every Tuesday as we learn about an artist or art style, then make art of our own.

entries.title: Financial Literacy for Teens
entries.description: Learn about managing credit cards and loans and some strategies you can use to fight back and make your money go further.

entries.title: Reading to Children with Ms. Lee
entries.description: \nParticipating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.

entries.title: Teen Voiceover Challenge
entries.description: TeenHQ’s recording studio wants to hear your best take on “The Birthday Card” Challenge.\nWe all love those hilarious birthday cards we receive or buy from the grocery store, but let’s put a voice to those funny words.

entries.title: Bascom Teens Reach Meeting: Canned Food Drive
entries.description: This program features funnbsp;volunteer opportunities,nbsp;craft activities, games, andnbsp;chances to hang out with your peers and learn new skills and information.To join Teens Reach you must be 13-18 years of age, have a strong interest in the library, enjoy working with people of all ages and cultures, and be willing to learn new skills.

entries.title: Virtual College Application Readiness for High Schoolers
entries.description: A free 45-60 minute talk on college readiness for high school students and their families.nbsp;We'll cover how admissions decisions actually get made, how to build a balanced college list, and application timelines for essays and testing.nbsp;\nFormat is a short presentation followed by open QA.

entries.title: Adaptive Activities Programming at Mount Pleasant Neighborhood Library
entries.description: Join us for socializing, finding new friends and having fun with art,crafts, and games!

entries.title: Indoor Family Storytime
entries.description: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Infant & Toddler Storytime
entries.description: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration.\nThis program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome!

entries.title: Playdates for Children and Their Caregivers
entries.description: Kids get to practice early social skills like sharing, taking turns, imitation of play, and joint attentionnbsp;while caregivers get a chance to connect. \nDon't miss out on this chance to celebrate the joys of play while connecting with other families in the community.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Childrennbsp;program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.nbsp;\nChildren will enjoy a small group interaction with our volunteer and it will be held under the Read to Children sign, within the Children's Area.\nFree.

entries.title: Game On!
entries.description: Our Nintendo Switch console is available for teens to play after school.nbsp; Controllers and games may be checked out at the Information Desk for IN LIBRARY USE ONLY.nbsp;nbsp;For teens 13-18.

entries.title: Lego Engineering

entries.title: Edenvale Teens Reach Meeting
entries.description: Teens Reach is the youth council for the San José Public Library, providing a key way for young adults to build their leadership skills by developing and participating in library activities, as well as becoming library advisors and advocates.

entries.title: Everyone Can Create: Drawing with Sketchbook
entries.description: We will explore creative tools and techniques using the popular Sketchbook app.\nWe will learn to use Sketchbook, a beginner drawing app for the iPad.

entries.title: Reading Buddy in English & Spanish
entries.description: Children in kindergartennbsp;through 3rd grade are invited to read aloud in English ornbsp;Spanish to trained teen volunteers who will offer encouragement and help with pronunciation when needed.

entries.title: Safe Routes to School Working Group Meetings for 2026-27
entries.description: Working Group meetings bring together these partners to discuss how to further the program's mission: to make it safer for students and families in Cupertino to get to and from school actively.

entries.title: Wacky Wednesdays: Litterbug craft

entries.description: Work one-on-one with an experienced writing instructor who will help you craft and revise your PIQs that avoid common mistakes and showcase the best of who you are to the admissions team.

entries.description: nbsp;All sessions will be held online using Zoom.\nChildrennbsp;ages 8-11nbsp;will learn how to solve difficult math problems as preparation for the MOEMSnbsp;math competition in middle school.

entries.description: Join your community to helpnbsp;beautify your Edenvale Branch Library.

entries.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines as a Branch Buddy
entries.description:
Volunteer Away Your Fines at 20 per hour and earn community service hours while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment.nbsp;
Volunteers may be asked to assist with:
Cleaning materials, bookshelves, furniture, and computersChildren's toys cleanup
Details and Requirements:
Must be able to commit to the 60-minute sessionAnyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardianNo experience or special skills necessaryThe library will provide supplies
Space is limited.

entries.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines as a Holiday Decorator
entries.description:
Details and Requirements:
• Must be able to commit to the full 1-hour session
• Anyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardian
• No experience or special skills necessary.

entries.title: Bollywood Dance
entries.description: Join us for this exciting volunteer-led program and learn Bollywood Dance moves for fun and fitness!

entries.description: Find a book that is funny, witty, or clever with themes such as dark humor, satire, or comedic reliefMay 20: Movie Adaptation May!

entries.title: Hindi for Everyday Life
entries.description: Perfectly tailored for learners from all backgrounds whether they hear Hindi at home or are exploring it for the very first time.\n The curriculum nurtures the four core language skills - Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing aligned with US Academic Standards andnbsp;the California World Languages Framework.

entries.title: Indoor Music and Movement
entries.description: nbsp;Music and Movement is a high energy Storytime - anbsp;fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of learning and movement.

entries.description: Bring your imagination to life with artist Arely Cardenas and Local Color's free ceramic dish painting workshop (for ages 5 and up).
